summary: Greek history of Rome's rise, including the Second Punic War.
bias_notes: Generally careful; close to the Scipio family, which colours his treatment of Paullus and Scipio. Patron bias: his account is shaped by his patrons; Aemilius Paullus, praised in his narrative, was the grandfather of his patron Scipio Aemilianus (excerpt; to verify). This, not hostility to Rome, is why his Cannae casualty figure (CLM-000026) is flagged.
title: Histories
reliability_notes: About 50–70 years from the events; spoke to survivors. Seems to have used some of the lost material by Silenus and Sosylus (SRC-000014); not recorded in derives_from because the doc says 'seems'.
